title: S5: Python call resolution on S3 and S4 (ADR 0008)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 (a1)-(a8): call sites over S3 (module graph) and S4 (symbols): scopes and name lookup, known-class bindings per ruling 3, self/cls, MRO, super(), cls(...), the four call bins with exact counts over call expressions, a construction as two edges (class and resolved __init__ along the MRO), Q1-Q4 scoring conventions, polymorphic sites flagged not guessed. Ships unwired (S7 wires, S8 runs the gate). Rules per case are committed before the code (part 1 rules commit, part 2 for the four rulings Q1-Q4 of the S5 questions).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Rules per case are committed before the code and the rules commit SHA is recorded on this task before the first code commit
Every call expression outside ERROR regions falls in exactly one of the four bins and the four counts sum to the number of call expressions
A construction of an in-repository class is one site with two edges (the class and its resolved __init__ along the MRO, including an inherited __init__)
self, cls, known-class bindings (ruling 3), super() and cls(...) are attributed; self.x.m() and every receiver needing inference is counted unresolved, never guessed
The click 7.1.2 and requests ground-truth call sites resolve through the S6 scorer shape with the bin counts recorded by SHA (not the gate run)
